description: Apple flagship smartphone with the A17 Pro chip, 6.1-inch display, and a triple-camera system.
Android smartphone with a built-in S Pen, 200MP camera, and a 6.8-inch AMOLED display.
Thin and light laptop with the Apple M3 chip and a 13-inch Liquid Retina display.
Windows creator laptop with Intel Core Ultra and a 15-inch OLED touchscreen.
Wireless over-ear noise-cancelling headphones with up to 30 hours of battery life.
Portable Bluetooth speaker with deep bass and a waterproof, rugged design.
Smartwatch with heart-rate and blood-oxygen sensors, an always-on Retina display, and GPS.
Fitness band that tracks heart rate, steps, and sleep with a seven-day battery.
4K OLED smart TV with webOS, Dolby Vision, and a 120Hz panel for gaming.
Cordless stick vacuum with laser dust detection and whole-machine HEPA filtration.
Electric pressure cooker that pressure-cooks, slow-cooks, steams, and sautes in one pot.
Compact 65W GaN fast charger with two USB-C ports for laptops and phones.
